newsitem.title: USA: Price Waterhouse revenues up 13 pct to new high.
newsitem.headline: Price Waterhouse revenues up 13 pct to new high.

text.p: Price Waterhouse Wednesday reported worldwide 1996, ended June 30, record net revenues of $5.02 billion saying they were up 13 percent over the previous 12 month period.

In the U.S., Price Waterhouse LLP's record revenues of $2.02 billion, up nearly 13 percent, marked the firm's third consecutive year of double digit growth, during which revenues have increased by 42 percent, it said.
In fiscal 1995, Price Waterhouse had combined worldwide revenues of $4.46 billion; U.S. revenues were $1.78 billion.

Worldwide revenues from Price Waterhouse management consulting services increased by more than 20 percent; revenues from audit and business advisory services and tax services each grew 10 percent, and revenues from corporate finance services rose 15 percent, the firm said.

U.S. growth also was led by Price Waterhouse's management consulting services, it said. Total revenues from the U.S. portion of PW's Information Technology and Change Integration practices increased by nearly 25 percent to a total of $687 million, 34 percent of the U.S. firm's overall revenues. --
